source: Bolcskei, Solt, Ceesay-Seitz, Razavi. Encarsia: Evaluating CPU Fuzzers via Automatic Bug Injection. USENIX Security 2025, Tables 8-10 (text extracted from https://comsec-files.ethz.ch/papers/encarsia_sec25.pdf, 2026-11-05)
protocol: 24 h of fuzzing per bug on a single core (Sec. 8.1); a bug counts as detected after the fuzzer's own false-positive filtering
id_mapping: paper bug k (1-15) = k-th EnCorpus bug directory in ascending numeric order (Encarsia Readme), separately for driver (signal mix-ups) and multiplexer (broken conditionals)
